text: 瑞银发表研究报告指，宁德时代第三季净利润为212亿元人民币，按年增长15%，但按季下跌6%，较买方预期低约10%。期内电池销量超过260GWh，当中储能系统占约25%，电动车电池占约75%。该行指出，按此计算的单位利润降至每千瓦时82元，创历史新低，主要受季度产品组合波动、低增值项目增加、9月1日起对锂离子电池征收消费税，以及出口增值税退税率由9%降至6%影响。不过，管理层对2027年行业20%至30%的增长前景仍保持信心。瑞银相应将该公司2026至2028年净利润预测下调11%至14%，降至介乎900亿至1,310亿元，目标价由820港元下调至730港
text_en: UBS said in a research report that CATL's third-quarter net profit was RMB 21.2 billion, up 15% year on year but down 6% quarter on quarter, about 10% below buy-side expectations. During the period, battery sales exceeded 260GWh, of which energy storage systems accounted for about 25% and EV batteries about 75%. The bank noted that on this basis, unit profit fell to RMB 82 per kWh, a record low, mainly affected by quarterly product mix fluctuations, an increase in low-value-added projects, the consumption tax levied on lithium-ion batteries starting September 1, and the export VAT rebate rate cut from 9% to 6%. However, management remains confident in the industry's 20% to 30% growth outlook for 2027. UBS accordingly cut its net profit forecasts for the company for 2026 to 2028 by 11% to 14% to a range of RMB 90 billion to RMB 131 billion, and lowered its target price from HK$820 to HK$730
